item.title: Road studs problem, 14th September
item.description:
As you approach Warden Hill on the Shurdington Road and intend to turn right onto Woodlands Road, there are road markings to clearly define the approach to the right turn, to ensure cars do not stray into the other part of the carriageway. Over the summer these white lines have worn away badly and when I drove up there this morning it was impossible to see any lines marking out the safe turning route. In poor light with high volumes of oncoming traffic, drivers attempting to turn right can easily stray and could easily lead to a collision. Please can this be addressed urgently, as it is a road safety issue.
Report on FixMyStreet
